verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud Agents documentation shows agents working in isolated Git worktrees, staging and committing changes, targeting branches, and opening pull requests (autoCreatePR flag, multi-repo repos array in the Cloud Agents API), plus Bugbot and Origin support reviewing, opening, and merging pull requests. This covers the full workflow described in the story with concrete mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of staging terminology and independent hands-on user confirmation that commit messages and branch creation work reliably in practice.
